blocks.text: You can download various Business Insights reports from the Reports page. The reports are generated on a monthly basis. The page contains the following reports:

blocks.item: Applications Report: Assessment of your application portfolio powered by AI, including but not limited to areas of cost savings, application overlap, and SaaS spending.
Workplaces Report: Assessment of your workplaces powered by AI, including but not limited to occupancy and attendance trends and least-used offices.
Go to Analytics > Reports > System Generated Reports.
Click the Download icon for the report you want to view.
The report is downloaded to your system for viewing.
